text: DSH Conversation Minimap 是面向 Web 客户端的对话轮次小地图。它通过会话标题工具栏入口和独立浮层显示每轮标记，并根据当前阅读位置突出活动轮次。用户可悬停或聚焦标记查看请求与助手结果摘要、状态及可用产出文件，也可激活标记跳转到对应轮次。需要浏览 DSH 会话历史并快速定位内容的用户可用它导航；代码未显示外部服务或密钥要求。

DSH Conversation Minimap adds a turn map to the web conversation view. Open it from the session header to preview turn summaries and status, then activate a marker to jump to that turn. It helps users browse conversation history. No external service or API key is shown in code.
想在很长的 DSH 对话里快速找到某一轮并跳过去。
能不能在聊天旁边显示每轮请求和回答的简短预览？
I want a visual map of conversation turns so I can jump to the part I am reading.
DSH Conversation Minimap 的功能「轮次预览与跳转」：每轮显示一个可访问标记，悬停或键盘聚焦时预览请求、回答摘要和状态，激活标记后滚动到该轮内容。
DSH Conversation Minimap 的功能「阅读位置与更早历史」：小地图突出当前阅读轮次，并提供按需加载更早轮次的入口；载入旧内容后恢复原阅读锚点。

@dsh-external/dsh-conversation-minimap README · dsh-conversation-minimap：`@dsh-external/dsh-conversation-minimap` adds a Codex-style conversation
minimap to DeepSeek Harness. One marker represents one engine-owned turn. The
current reading turn is emphasized, hover or keyboard focus opens a compact
preview, and activating a marker scrolls directly to that turn.

@dsh-external/dsh-conversation-minimap README · dsh-conversation-minimap：The plugin is additive. It registers a layout-neutral entry in
`conversation.session.header.utilities`, locates that session's semantic
`[data-conversation-scroll]`, and renders the rail through its own portal. It
does not replace the conversation body, change the conversation width, scrape
rendered prose, or depend on CSS-module hashes.

@dsh-external/dsh-conversation-minimap README · Install：Build the source checkout and add it to an isolated Harness Web profile:

```powershell
pnpm install
pnpm run build

cd C:\Users\lumoren\Documents\GitHub\deepseek-harness

For source rebuilds without restarting the host, run `pnpm run dev:web` from
the Harness checkout in a second terminal.

@dsh-external/dsh-conversation-minimap README · Behavior：- Wide conversation columns receive a left-side rail with exactly one visual
  mark and one accessible button per turn. Short histories stay in a compact,
  fixed-spacing cluster around the rail center; long histories progressively
  expand through the available height. Only the active reading turn receives
  the long, high-contrast mark.
- Narrow columns receive a compact header utility that opens the same rail.
- Hover and focus show a wide, theme-token glass preview with crisp request and
  result text, status, and up to four produced paths. The preview keeps its
  pointer handoff when the cursor moves from a marker into the card.
- Click, Enter, or Space scrolls to the first mounted row for the turn.
- Earlier history is loaded only on request; the current reading anchor is
  preserved while the older page is inserted.
- Conversation opening, older-page loading, and a failed page request are
  surfaced in the rail without replacing the host conversation status.
- Every marker is a real button with an accessible label and `aria-current` on
  the active reading turn.
- `prefers-reduced-motion` is observed live. Smooth scrol

@dsh-external/dsh-conversation-minimap README · Behavior：An application or theme can disable the minimap for a subtree:

```html
<section data-dsh-conversation-minimap="off">...</section>
```

@dsh-external/dsh-conversation-minimap README · Compatibility：The package targets the semantic conversation contracts in Harness
`0.1.0-rc.5` and the published `0.1.0-rc.6` client line. It is tested with the
default `light` and `dark` themes plus `angelina-light` and `angelina-dark`.
Theme colors come from `--dsw-alias-*` tokens with system-color fallbacks.

@dsh-external/dsh-conversation-minimap README · Development：```powershell
pnpm run check
pnpm run pack:check
```

Optional Playwright acceptance tests use an already running isolated profile:

```powershell
$env:DSH_MINIMAP_E2E_URL = 'http://127.0.0.1:3000/'
pnpm run test:e2e
```

The runtime has no polling loop, interval, or permanent animation frame. Its
MutationObserver is scoped to the active conversation scrollport; all
observers, listeners, portal nodes, styles, timers, and requested frames are
released with the session entry.

@dsh-external/dsh-conversation-minimap README · Distribution faces：- `.`: no-op Node half mounted by the Harness Loader.
- `./client`: browser Cordis plugin registered through `__ModuleLoader__`.
- `./cordis.patch.yml`: profile patch that adds the Loader row.

@dsh-external/dsh-conversation-minimap README · dsh-conversation-minimap：`@dsh-external/dsh-conversation-minimap` 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加 Codex 风格的
对话小地图。每个标记对应一个由会话引擎维护的轮次；当前阅读轮次会被强调，
悬停或键盘聚焦可以查看摘要，激活标记会直接滚动到该轮内容。

预览内容来自 Harness 的公开 Conversation Snapshot，可显示：

- 用户请求摘要；
- 该轮最后一段助手结果；
- 运行中、完成、失败或停止状态；
- 可选 `ui-deliverables` 功能发布的产出文件。

插件采用附加式接入：在 `conversation.session.header.utilities` 注册一个不占
布局的入口，通过语义标记定位本会话的 `[data-conversation-scroll]`，再用独立
Portal 渲染轨道。它不会替换会话主体、改变聊天列宽、抓取页面文字或依赖 CSS
Module 哈希。

@dsh-external/dsh-conversation-minimap README · 安装：构建本地源码并安装到隔离的 Harness Web profile：

```powershell
pnpm install
pnpm run build

cd C:\Users\lumoren\Documents\GitHub\deepseek-harness

需要源码热重建时，在第二个终端进入 Harness 仓库运行 `pnpm run dev:web`。

@dsh-external/dsh-conversation-minimap README · 行为：- 宽聊天列显示左侧内容轨道：每轮严格对应一个视觉标记和一个可访问按钮。
  短会话以固定间距紧凑聚合在轨道中央，轮次增多后才渐进展开到可用高度；
  只有当前阅读轮次显示为高对比长标记。窄聊天列收缩为顶栏小地图按钮。
- 悬停和聚焦显示宽幅主题玻璃预览卡，标题和结果文字保持清晰，并显示状态以及
  最多四个产出路径；鼠标从标记移入卡片时预览不会立即消失。
- 点击、Enter 或 Space 跳转到该轮首个已挂载节点。
- 更早历史只在用户主动触发时加载，插入旧消息后恢复原阅读锚点。
- 会话打开、加载更早页面以及分页失败会在轨道中显示，不替换宿主会话状态。
- 每个标记都是可访问按钮，当前阅读轮次使用 `aria-current`。
- 实时遵守 `prefers-reduced-motion`，减少动效时取消平滑滚动和位移。

应用或主题可以显式关闭某个子树的小地图：

```html
<section data-dsh-conversation-minimap="off">...</section>
```

@dsh-external/dsh-conversation-minimap README · 兼容性：插件面向 Harness `0.1.0-rc.5` 本地源码以及已发布的 `0.1.0-rc.6` 客户端包，
覆盖默认 `light`、`dark` 与 `angelina-light`、`angelina-dark`。颜色优先读取
`--dsw-alias-*` 语义变量，缺失时使用系统颜色回退。

插件与 `dsh-motion` 相互独立。自身 Portal 使用 `data-dsh-motion="off"` 防止
重复动画，Harness 的其他界面仍由宿主、主题和 `dsh-motion` 正常管理。

@dsh-external/dsh-conversation-minimap README · 开发：```powershell
pnpm run check
pnpm run pack:check
```

可选 Playwright 验收连接到已经运行的隔离 profile：

```powershell
$env:DSH_MINIMAP_E2E_URL = 'http://127.0.0.1:3000/'
pnpm run test:e2e
```

运行时没有轮询、`setInterval` 或常驻动画帧。MutationObserver 只观察当前会话
滚动容器；会话入口卸载时会释放全部 observer、事件监听、Portal、样式、计时器
和已请求的动画帧。

- `./client`：通过 `__ModuleLoader__` 注册的浏览器 Cordis 插件。
- `./cordis.patch.yml`：向 profile 插入 Loader row 的补丁。
